subject: qqcode
title: Backend tests ride real provider API-response fixtures through respx, with a documented fixture-refresh policy
one_why: Fixtures are hand-trimmed real API payloads per provider with an explicit policy that closer-to-real means more reliable tests; cheap way to make adapter tests track wire reality without live keys.

subject: qqcode
title: Compaction trigger reads billed usage every turn; exact recount done once via a max_tokens=16 probe at compact time
one_why: Free per-turn accounting from response usage, and the expensive tokenizer-exact probe is paid only at compact, with the 16-token floor noted as an OpenRouter quirk workaround.

subject: qqcode
title: Anthropic OAuth path injects the verbatim Claude Code system-prompt prefix and oauth beta header to pass the subscription gate
one_why: Lighter sibling of claurst's stealth stack: user-agent stays honestly 'QQcode/' and there is no TLS-fingerprint or client-hash spoofing, but the required 'You are Claude Code' prefix + anthropic-beta oauth-2025-04-20 still rides Claude Code's subscription entitlement - ToS-gray, revocation-prone; port the Qwen device-flow shape, not this one.

subject: qqcode
title: Prefix startswith allow/deny over shell-split segments lets allowlist ALWAYS verdicts smuggle substitutions
one_why: Segments are split on &&/||/;/| (good), but 'date $(rm -rf /)' matches allowlist prefix 'date' and executes without approval; deny side is fail-closed so blast radius is limited to allowlisted prefixes - still the known command-prefix bypass class.

subject: qqcode
title: Generic backend stamps cache_control ephemeral markers (system block + sliding penultimate message) for cache-capable OpenAI-style providers
one_why: Explicit Anthropic-style prompt caching offered on the generic adapter for providers like Qwen, keeping 100% prefix-cache hits on the system prompt while the conversation marker slides; no tests cover the marker placement.

subject: qqcode
title: Lint gate is '|| true' and both snapshot jobs are continue-on-error in CI
one_why: Pre-commit (ruff/pyright) never fails a build and snapshot diffs only upload an artifact, so the repo's static-typing rules advertised in AGENTS.md have zero enforcement teeth; the core pytest job itself does gate properly (ci.yml:86).

subject: qqcode
title: SkillManager discovers SKILL.md frontmatter across project/user search paths and injects only an index; bodies load on demand via the skill tool
one_why: Convergent Claude-style skills support in the vibe lineage, with tested discovery/precedence (tests/skills/); reinforces the corpus-wide convergence count.

subject: qqcode
title: Four product surfaces (textual CLI, VS Code webview, Zed extension, GitHub Action) all hang off one ACP server with per-session permission-option mapping
one_why: Unusual at 31k LOC: the internal client contract is the public ACP protocol itself, and ACP approvals are wired back through the same ToolDecision path the CLI uses (tested in tests/acp/, 882-LOC suite + 10 companions).
